description: Whispering, which Epicenter bundles (`bundled_apps.rs`), runs in one window per folder, labelled whispering:<digest of the folder's directory>. The shell binds each window's one folder to it before the window exists, and the window reaches no other. The page opens that folder with the folder plugin and listens for its change event. It holds its window's close until what is typed saved, brings unfinished input forward (core:window:allow-set-focus), and destroys its own window only after saving (core:window:allow-destroy). It lists the microphones, reads one's level, and records into that folder through the recorder plugin, which asks macOS for microphone access first and finalizes a recording when the window is destroyed (ADR-0543, ADR-0571), and opens System Settings at a privacy pane through the opener (`x-apple.systempreferences:` only, ADR-0555). It transcribes with the one active local model, reads whether that model is ready, and opens Settings, where that model is chosen (ADR-0180); it administers no model. It reads and saves its two AI connection rows in Epicenter's own folder, so.epicenter, by operation and never by path, sends AI requests over its connections, saves a connection's key and reads whether one is saved, never the key, through the narrow CLI runner (ADR-0557), and reads who Epicenter is signed in as for an Epicenter connection (ADR-0558). It runs no folder history and no account request. Its page is served on the epicenter-app scheme, so the capability is local (ADR-0561).
